title: Child repos run each CI suite once per batch
why: R64, owner 16:01 CST Nov 12: "ill bring other repos in compliance only if there's free time on the runners". Read 15:52 CST: q_max reruns its 12-shard test tier on push (harness/ci-changes.mjs:8-9, :131-132); degen reruns server and 4 app shards on push.
source: retrospective 15:59 and 16:02 CST Nov 12; store r64
note: Held: start only when runners have free time (owner 16:01 CST). Compliance lanes per decision session-tiers "Child repos"; coordinator checks q_max and degen for an active coordinator first. Owner answers 12:14 CST Nov 13: item 722 a (q_max skips the push suite on a proven tree; ruling qmax-skips-push-suite) and item 723 a (degen, after its red-main check; ruling degen-skips-push-suite). Item 729: the owner answered a against the OLD wording (joyous-only skip); the item was rewritten at 12:06 CST (a = shared CI form for every repo, c = joyous-only). Not acted on; he is asked to confirm. Item 724 (q_max test beside checks) rewritten with option c (together only on the batch run); open. Mailaudit #322 closes as not worth it (stood pick 732).
